methodology.unit_of_sample: one map, not one timing call
methodology.includes: same grid validation; search; stats; complete path reconstruction; solve dispatch
methodology.excludes: BFS reference, maps generation, plotting, file IO; trace disabled
methodology.matched_control: uniform_search shares all code except the frontier container adapter
methodology.ratios: variant / deque BFS per map, then aggregate; below one means less
methodology.memory_metric: frontier record count, not total bytes; no claim of causal isolation across different codebases
